notes.title: [Major Bug Fix] Steam Deck Input issues solved
notes.notes:
A major bug that caused the input to lag on Steam Deck or Linux + Proton [b]while playing with a joypad[/b] has finally been fixed. Thank you for your patience and massive thanks to everyone who helped fixing it!

[h2]Long version[/h2]

[h3]The bug[/h3]
Several users reported input lag spikes after playing through the game's story or tutorial mode on Steam Deck. The issue only happened when playing with a joypad and only on Steam Deck or Linux + Proton (albeit more rarely), while Windows was completely unaffected.

[h3]The cause[/h3]
Back in 2016, I edited the irrlicht source code to allow for detecting joypads more than once. The original behavior was to keep adding joypads at every new detection, effectively duplicating the list. This was fine at the time because the function to detect joypads was meant to be called [b]only once[/b], when the game started up.

My modification cleared the list of detected joypads before starting a new detection, to solve this issue. Unfortunately, what I didn't do was also [b]releasing the already detected devices[/b], which somehow still lingered in memory, [b]causing the input events to be duplicated or missed entirely[/b] after enough detections had been triggered.

[h3]The solution[/h3]
The solution to this bug was going back to that 2016 code and [b]release all the previously detected devices before clearing the list[/b]. This apparently was the core of the issue.

[h2]Special thanks[/h2]
My thanks go to the members of the community that helped me tackle this nasty bug, since I didn't own a Steam Deck to check it. In no particular order:

[list]
[*] [b]Desaeta[/b], who first reported the bug and helped me find the root cause (see this [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1287800/discussions/0/4343240316590618709/]thread[/url])
[*] [b]Gamingjunkie222[/b] for confirming the bug independently on Twitter, which made things easier to deal with (i.e. showing me it wasn't a bug that just affected one single user)
[*] [b]GamingWarthog[/b] and [b]4C3M4N777[/b], who verified that the fix is indeed working as intended
[/list]

notes.title: Schwarzerblitz - Candidate v1.6 Release available in the endless-beta branch
notes.notes:
[h1]One last huge update[/h1]
Schwarzerblitz v1.6 is coming soon as a last big update... and I need all the player feedback I can get! The release candidate version is available in the [b]endless-beta[/b] branch of the game. To access it:
[list]
[*] Right Click on Schwarzerblitz in your Steam Library
[*] Select [b]Beta[/b]
[*] Input the password [b]mysteryjohnson[/b] to access the endless-beta channel
[*] Switch to the endless-beta channel and let the game update
[/list]
[h2]A new character[/h2]
[b]Lucia Lunarossa[/b], originally released as a Workshop character, will be added to the game in an official form as character #28, to be unlocked by clearing Arcade mode with Mira and Lazor OR Leo and Rattlebone OR Renzo, Mono, Wally and Shaz. She sports an updated and more polished moveset (and, hopefully, more balanced), while still having access to all her transformations

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37436603/218e7b5c03e7272a93a5e3f47fec1f0bf08e91d5.png[/img]

[h2]A new juggle system[/h2]
The juggle system has been revamped to allow for more freeform combos. Every character has now access to a universal launcher that costs one Bullet Counter and a new evasion mechanic called Trigger Escape. A new tutorial section has been added specifically to address this new content.
Each character will also receive [b]a new combo trial[/b] that makes use of the new juggle mechanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37436603/6fe258ba2fb8ae5ad6bfa5dee279efc2b257c65b.png[/img]

[h2]Version select[/h2]
You've read it right! All the characters[b] have now access to most of their old movesets[/b], ranging from the very first 2017 Alpha version to the latest update. Version select must be toggled in the options and changes, among other things, how gravity, juggles, mechanics and wake up options behave. If you want a taste of an older Schwarzerblitz version, be sure to check it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37436603/3b1f270288a80695a259ed56ca6e9d0c66d0a681.png[/img]

[h2]Unlockable story characters[/h2]
Previously unplayable characters that appeared during the story, such as Army Soldier and Broken Krave, can now be unlocked for Free Match. They can be selected by keeping the Trigger button pressed down while hovering on a certain character.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37436603/1cc3053422247ca0b80ac641c33c2d1048e014fb.png[/img]

[h2]To cry wolf[/h2]
In addition to the above, there is also a new secret arcade boss fight. The conditions to get it are pretty hard, but not impossible if you have already met and beaten Arkaneis in Arcade Mode:
[list]
[*] Don't get any Perfect wins before match #3. If you meet K-069 at any moment during your run, you failed this condition.
[*] Obtain at least 2 Perfect wins after match #3.
[*] Play at Hard or higher.
[*] Win two times or more by Ring Out
[*] Never lose a round nor continue
[*] Defeat Doll in match #6
[*] The new boss will replace Donner as the final arcade boss
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37436603/195140db2353946fd3b9830aba4a06c492e8d768.jpg[/img]

[h2]Quality of life improvements[/h2]
As one last thing, there will be a couple bug fixes and general improvements, such as:
[list]
[*] Replaced some old animations, such as the universal backdash and Kiyoko's run
[*] Improved Record&Replay function in Training Mode
[*] A 3-frames buffer for making links more consistent
[*] A general rebalancing of the cast
[*] Small improvements to the CPU-controlled opponent logic
[/list]

The update will drop within a couple months, so any additional feedback NOW is well appreciated!

notes.title: [Bug fix] Pressing Trigger while advancing won't cause unwanted running
notes.notes:
Due to some unintended behavior, pressing the Trigger button while walking forward would automatically make the character run. This made it very difficult to start Trigger Combos with moves that included a forward direction. The behavior has been fixed to remove this.
Pressing Forward + Trigger together at the same time, however, will still result in a run.

As anticipated last week, Schwarzerblitz is now updated to version 1.4.6, featuring three new costumes, a new stage and several grammar and small bug fixes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37436603/6ff31e0909d3a7db28741538a1c795ffd795b3b2.jpg[/img]

[h2]New content[/h2]
[list]
[*] Shaz got a new "Mascot" costume! To unlock it, clear the story episode "Burial at Sea";
[*] Sir Rattlebone got a new "Perfect Disguise" costume! To unlock it, clear arcade mode with him once or complete his moveset trial;
[*] Emperor Arkaneis got a "[url=https://twitter.com/FrostyFaustings]Frosty Faustings XIV[/url]" celebration costume too! This one is unlocked from the beginning;
[*] Emperor Arkaneis has now his own moveset trial (it is not required to obtain the "All trials complete" achievement)
[*] There is a new stage, "Beyond the Limit", which is accessible from the beginning. The BGM used in the stage can be listened to in the in-game jukebox

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37436603/4e6b1218e2536875469552c4792fb951048f4de5.jpg[/img]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]

[*] grammar and spelling review (thanks to the members of the Schwarzerblitz Discord server!);
[*] Kaya's moveset trial now shows the correct input for her Sword Throw move in the description;
[*] Lazor's trial was fixed, as some moves were not registering as done, even when executed correctly.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37436603/c0e0c6277651ae02156369fff728421ffb2c76a1.png[/img]

[h2]Important note[/h2]
As a result of the update, the individual progress in most story chapters will be set again to 0%, but completed chapters will still be marked as such - so, nothing will be lost except checkpoints if you were currently playing a specific story chapter. I apologize for the inconvenience!

This will be the last patch for a while, unless there is any urgent bug to fix! I hope you will enjoy this small amount of new content, which doubles as a "Thank you!" for sticking with this game for so long!

notes.title: [IMPORTANT!] Schwarzerblitz v 1.2.7 - beta branch patch with major AI bug fix
notes.notes:
This patch applies ONLY to the endless-beta branch of the game. To opt-in, right click on Schwarzerblitz in your Steam library, select Properties, Beta and use the password [b]mysteryjohnson [/b]to unlock it.
[b]This is the last beta update before the release of version 1.3 of the game[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37436603/041298147d2b487fdf849a77085e63bacad9ba62.png[/img]

[h1]Dear players, I apologize[/h1]
In the past four months, I have received wildly different reports about the game's difficulty. Some players found the difficulty pitiful, while some couldn't beat the arcade boss at Medium without summoning the help of eldritch fiends and asking for the intercession of the power that be. This wild swing was not only unexpected, but also concerning.
Furthermore, watching videos uploaded on YT by different players, I noticed that the difficulty seemed wildly inconsistent even when the difficulty settings were the same.

Well, I've finally found the culprit.

There was a nasty, hidden, vicious bug that made the game's difficulty dependent on the [b]frame rate of the PC the game was run on.[/b] This made the game a lot easier when played on high end PCs and much, much harder (borderline impossible) when played on lower-end PCs, causing the above differences.

I won't get into the technical details of the error (for those interested, a basic explanation can be found [url=https://twitter.com/AndreaDProjects/status/1318254240402427908?s=20]here, on my Twitter account[/url]), but suffices to say that what made the game impossible (or too easy) for you to play might have been a honest developer mistake.

I have fixed the bug and I will roll out the update to all branches at the end of the month. That said, you can already try the new version out in the endless-beta branch (password: [b]mysteryjohnson[/b]). I hope you will enjoy the change, but for any feedback do not hesitate to open a community hub!
